functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Hooks around the dorsal (Lister's) tubercle of the radius -- a documented bones.json landmark -- changing its line of pull, unlike APL/EPB which run straight to the thumb.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

trigger_points.location_description: Not mapped by Travell and Simons; the source document infers a taut band in the EPL belly in the deep dorsal forearm distal to abductor pollicis longus. [clinical reasoning]
trigger_points.referred_pain_pattern: Dorsal thumb and dorsoradial wrist pain is inferred; the documented remote sources of dorsal thumb pain are supinator (dorsal thumb web and proximal thumb) and brachialis (base of thumb). [clinical reasoning -- not a Travell & Simons figure for EPL itself]
trigger_points.notes: Non-myofascial differential: EPL tenosynovitis or rupture, distal intersection syndrome, dorsal wrist ganglion, scapholunate injury, basal-joint arthritis, C6 radiculopathy.
trigger_points.source: Simons, Travell & Simons (1999) Trigger Point Manual, 2nd ed., Vol. 1; Donnelly et al. (2019) 3rd ed. -- no distinct EPL figure exists in either edition; pattern is labelled [clinical reasoning] in this atlas's uploaded wrist muscle reference.
